label: Mokosh system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Mokosh locus represented by MkoA/MkoB type I or MkoC type II components that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Mokosh branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual mkoA, mkoB, or mkoC genes, MkoA, MkoB, or MkoC proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Mokosh locus, unresolved Mokosh trigger or effector activities, Mokosh type I or type II subtypes, and other phage defense systems.
